critical_failures.issue: Classified an explicit full-year guidance increase as a regulatory catalyst.
Set conflicting_articles despite receiving one uniformly negative article.

POS.notes: Sentiment, direction, materiality, and article reference were correct; catalyst type was unsupported.

NEG.notes: Regulatory negative classification was correct; conflicting_articles was internally unsupported.

MIX.notes: Correct positive and negative article assessments, mixed overall sentiment, and negative guidance catalyst.

NONE.notes: Python generated NO_RECENT_NEWS abstention without invoking Ollama.

decision: Do not enable NEWS synthesis or persistence with this model yet.
